items.title: How AI Power Demand Transformed Caterpillar (CAT) into a High-Multiple Tech Play

items.title: Caterpillar (CAT) Commits $100 Million To AI And Robotics Training
items.summary: Caterpillar (NYSE:CAT) is rolling out new AI tools across industrial and construction operations, drawing on its experience with autonomous mining systems. Caterpillar has committed $100 million to workforce training focused on AI and robotics adoption.
